title: Country dialing code lookup without hand-aligned columns
task: Package `phone` needs `DialingCode(country string) (string, error)` for at least these ISO codes: PH +63, US +1, GB +44, JP +81, DE +49, BR +55, IN +91, AU +61. An unknown code is an error mentioning the code. Lay the table out so gofmt is happy and the lines stay short; do not pad it into columns by hand, and keep the table where the lookup can find it without a package-level variable. Test two known codes and an unknown one.
